task: Implement Slice 1 of the frozen spec .ai/pass-spec.md: enemy target-selection clarity and onboarding hint (battle UI), independent Music/SFX volume settings with a SOUND popover and migration (audio), and hero-specific verb-success SFX plus AP-gain chime, travelling +1 energy mote and AP segment pop (quiz training strike + AP meter).
requirements: Follow section 'Slice 1' of .ai/pass-spec.md exactly (1A targeting, 1B sound settings, 1C verb-success feedback, Slice 1 tests). It is the controller-approved design.

Preserve what is already on master: Stage 3/4 share SEE_JA_SPEAK_EN in src/engine.js; the streak badge stays wrapped with the dummy and centred above it; Stage Clear stays title -> hero scene + nameplate -> AP meter -> AP note -> BATTLE!.
Keep the existing targeting logic (cycleTarget/selectTarget, data-select-uid); this is discoverability and visuals. Selecting an enemy never attacks.

Music and SFX volumes are fully independent: defaults 0.12 each, keys esl-verbs-music-volume / esl-verbs-sfx-volume, clamp 0..1, malformed values -> default, one-time migration from esl-verbs-music='off' -> music 0. Ducking is relative to the chosen music volume. Live music changes never restart the track.

Replace every MUSIC ON/OFF toggle with one SOUND button + document-level popover (native range inputs, >=44px rows, Escape/outside click closes, battle keys ignored while open, survives battle re-renders).

Training strike: per-hero weapon/cast sfx and separate impact sfx at the TRAINING_STRIKE timings, then a +1 mote travels to the AP meter; AP set + segment pop + apGain chime happen on arrival. No extra quiz delay; AP never lost or doubled; reduced-motion path.
Targeting onboarding uses an in-memory session flag (never localStorage), intro -> quiet after the first real target change.
Add the tests listed under 'Slice 1 tests'; keep all existing tests passing; npm run balance output must stay byte-identical (battle numbers untouched).

Append dated DESIGN_DECISIONS.md entries for the decisions made (sound popover replacing the music toggle, 12% defaults + migration, target hint levels via session state, success feedback sequence). Revise stale CURRENT_STATE.md lines (music toggle, AP feedback, targeting) instead of appending logs.
constraints: Do not touch src/battle-engine.js, src/battle-data.js, src/region.js, src/story.js, src/pixel-enemies.js, src/pixel-effects.js, src/station-map.js or src/battle-locations.js (other slices own them).
No new runtime dependency, no build step, no framework, no canvas animation loop, no large-area CSS filters. Effects are CSS / light DOM.
1024x600 must not page-scroll on the quiz, Stage Clear or battle screens; the target hint must not cover enemy sprites, plates, intents or status badges.
Edit source with structured edit tools; on the first shell quoting/escaping failure switch to file edit tools.
Do not commit. Do not delete .ai files.

notes: createBattleView re-renders container.innerHTML on every render; anything that must persist (the sound popover) lives outside it on document.body.
battle-ui onKeydown is a document listener: it already bails when .modal-backdrop exists; add the same bail-out while the sound popover is open or focus is inside it.

audio.js: musicLevel()/applyLevel() compute the music gain with DUCK ratios against MUSIC_VOLUME; sfx() currently returns when !enabled, which must become sfxVolume <= 0. The silent fallback object (no AudioContext) needs the same new API.
app.js: musicToggle()/musicToggleMarkup()/paintMusicToggle and the [data-music-toggle] document click handler are the toggles to replace; showBattle passes topRight: musicToggleMarkup().
app.js trainingStrike(): TRAINING_STRIKE has per-hero pose/projectile/launch/hit/impact; land() currently sets the AP at impact and plays sfx('hit').
ap-meter.js is one persistent node mounted into each screen's slot; the fill is a width bar with notches, so the segment pop is an absolutely positioned overlay at index*10%.
Browser test runs with PLAYWRIGHT_PATH=C:/Users/nolan/ui-verify/node_modules/playwright; debug entry points: ?debug=battle, ?debug=quiz&stage=N&hero=X.
